* Body

Checkout is the company's flagship payment-acceptance product. It handles cart abandonment recovery, multi-currency pricing, and PCI-compliant token vaulting. The auth layer sits at the edge of every request path, making the JWT refactor a high-risk, high-visibility project. Checkout's rollout pipeline supports staged canary deploys with automatic rollback triggers.
